name: Jac
caption: Which one did you stop first? Comment the number 👇

slides.text:
5 things the black sheep stopped doing

(that changed everything)

1. Asking permission to live differently

Your life doesn't need a vote.

The people who love you will catch up. The rest were never meant to.

2. Explaining themselves to everyone

Not everyone is ready to hear it.

The ones who are meant to understand, WILL.

3. Consuming before creating

The first hour of the day used to belong to the feed.

Now it belongs to them.

4. Choosing comfort over truth

At some point, the comfortable lies stopped feeling comfortable.

That's when everything started to change.

5. Waiting for the herd

They stopped waiting for everyone to wake up first.

They just WALK. And the right ones follow.

If you've stopped even one of these,

you're already the black sheep.

Follow @jac_lavoiee. There are more of us than you think.
